method: Each check breaks one thing the lot added, in an isolated copy of 59a76487 plus this lot, rebuilds the project the named tests live in, runs them, and writes the original bytes back (never git checkout). Every named test must fail and the named neighbour must stay green. Controls run after restoring: the spoken-text guard, render-refusal and cross-cutting unit tests, and the stored-summary, product-name dial and canonical-task integration TestIds. The number-shaped case of IT-DB-TASK-SUMMARY-12 was added before the checks ran, so the whole-text check has a case only it catches. The combined tree is re-verified on main in the README.
